economy.zh:
今日经济焦点集中于两大事件：中国芯片巨头长鑫存储（CXMT）以约470%的惊人涨幅上市，创下A股历史纪录，同时中东局势出现短暂缓和迹象，伊朗据报道暂停攻击，导致原油暴跌5%。但中国经济数据喜忧参半，工业利润增速在6月继续放缓，而车市价格战因利润率挤压难以为继。欧洲市场在波动后企稳，ECB官员拉加德表态将完成任期。以下是各板块详细解读。

- **长鑫存储上市引爆A股**：合肥内存芯片制造商CXMT在上海科创板首日飙升至约470%涨幅，市值超越茅台成为A股最贵公司，融资约86亿美元（亚洲最大IPO）。AI芯片需求和中国自主化战略是核心驱动，但需警惕过度投机风险。详见[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/cxmt-china-market-debut-chipmaker-ipo.html)及[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9q9w3x9qn2o)。
- **中国工业利润增速放缓**：6月工业利润增速再次回落，主要受油价下跌拖累，但全年仍有望保持双位数增长（上半年从2025年的微增大幅反弹）。详见[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/china-industrial-profit-growth-exports-oil-drops.html)。
- **中东局势出现转机，原油暴跌**：伊朗据报道愿在美国暂停攻击条件下暂停攻击，WTI和布伦特原油大跌5%，美股期货应声上涨。但此前24小时Trump才宣称继续攻击导致油价涨7%，市场波动剧烈，地缘不确定性仍高。详见[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/oil-price-wti-brent-slide-as-iran-reportedly-may-halt-attacks.html)及[MarketWatch](https://news.google.)。
- **中国车市价格战遇瓶颈**：利润率下滑（因原材料成本上升）正限制车企降价空间，尽管销量下滑，折扣力度可能不及预期。详见[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361876/lower-profit-margins-set-foil-chinese-carmakers-price-war-plans-despite-falling-sales)。
- **Shein转亏，香港上市在即**：快时尚巨头Shein一季度亏损9900万美元，因西方关税挤压利润，但仍计划赴港上市。详见[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361931/fast-fashion-giant-shein-swings-usm-99m-first-quarter-loss-ahead-hong-kong-listing)。
- **欧洲市场企稳，拉加德“基线”为完成任期**：巴黎CAC 40微涨至8340点，ECB首席经济学家Lane发布欧元区展望，拉加德表示将完成8年任期，政策连续性可期。详见[BBN Times](https://news.google.)及[tovima.com](https://news.google.)。

**后续观察**：本周美联储将公布7月利率决议，市场预期按兵不动，但措辞值得关注；同时多家中概股及Yum China等财报将密集发布。中东局势的反复仍是最大变量，若伊朗暂停得以维持，油价可能进一步回落，利好全球通胀预期。中国方面，CXMT的财富效应能否带动A股整体企稳，尚需观察。
economy.en: Markets entered a fresh week on a jolt of volatility. Oil prices swung wildly after Iran signaled a potential halt to attacks if a U.S. pause holds, only to reverse course after President Trump vowed to continue strikes. Meanwhile, China’s memory chip champion CXMT launched the biggest IPO in Asia this year, surging more than 470% on its Shanghai debut and single-handedly reviving sentiment in battered A-shares. The juxtaposition of geopolitical risk and a domestic tech boom defined trading across desks. Key macro data showed China’s industrial profit growth slowing for a second month, while Europe’s central bank chief cemented expectations for a steady policy hand. Below, we unpack the key moves and what they mean for portfolios.

society.zh:
今日国际社会新闻焦点集中在欧洲安全与中东动荡。柏林Pride游行遭汽车撞击袭击，嫌疑人被警方击毙，凸显极端主义威胁。俄乌互相空袭导致平民伤亡，乌克兰切尔尼戈夫超市遇袭致6死包括一名儿童。以色列定居者在西岸纵火焚烧清真寺和农田，巴以冲突持续升级。马里北部冲突因分离主义与基地组织结盟进入危险新阶段。阿根廷总统米莱在巴西公开辱骂巴西总统为“小偷”，南美外交关系恶化。法国波尔多附近山火迫使33万人撤离，欧洲高温野火频发。此外，澳大利亚一国党领袖汉森因种族歧视言论被法院维持原判。后续观察：柏林袭击后德国将加强安保；俄乌和谈前景渺茫；马里局势可能引发更大范围恐怖主义扩散；南美政治裂痕加深。

society.en:
The global social news landscape over the past 24 hours is dominated by violent attacks, geopolitical tensions, and a major intellectual achievement. A car-ramming attack at Berlin Pride ends with the suspect shot dead by police, while conflict-related casualties continue in Ukraine, the West Bank, and Mali. In Europe, massive wildfires force hundreds of thousands to evacuate. The scientific community celebrates two Chinese mathematicians winning the Fields Medal, sparking national pride and debate. Meanwhile, Japan grapples with labor shortages amid cultural shifts, and a French report on a child's death raises questions about China's medical ambitions.

- **Berlin Pride Attack**: A suspect drove a car into a crowd near Tiergarten, killing several; Chancellor Merz called it 'heinous.' The attacker, Abdul Ballout, was later shot dead during a police operation after rushing officers with a knife. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cevmdxz4872o), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62eg899l99o)
- **Ukraine-Russia Attacks**: Russian strikes killed six, including a child at a supermarket in Chernihiv; Ukrainian strikes killed four on the Russian side. Meanwhile, UK PM Burnham pledged continued support ahead of Zelensky’s visit. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/27/russia-and-ukraine-trade-attacks-killing-10-including-child-in-chernihiv), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8me5vyjg2o)
- **West Bank Violence**: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques and cars in multiple villages, escalating after a deadly clash two days prior that left six dead. Netanyahu also accused NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' over an arrest threat related to ICC warrant. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjrv77gl4deo), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yegvd9ddeo)
- **Wildfires in France and Spain**: Over 330,000 people evacuated as firefighters battle a massive blaze near Bordeaux. The heatwave continues to strain resources. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyj8k4nn5jo)
- **Fields Medal Glory and Controversy**: Two Chinese scholars, including Deng Yu, win the Fields Medal. On Zhihu, users debate Deng's unconventional path and mental state, while state media caution against overconfidence. [thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1BU2JKZm1IN0Q1c29VdzlseE9WWXFZQjI3RGxlOWtsd0dMOUdmRFdsdG0tN0UyZl9saHlMNzA3ODNhdG5PUFkyenJhWGJuMDN0Y1l1MU9CMjZSejJyWmQ4eA), [风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5GNVZPdVpQWFY0bUdWUFR5NEx3T29PR0RGLWZhWkRIMTJtVXA5Mi1IeFJNTm1oT29fZ244VG5NODVDTldxVEM4ZGJfaDNTSzdiRXlVZFRHYW0tcFU)
- **Argentina-Brazil Diplomatic Spat**: President Milei called Brazil's president a 'thief' and 'convict' at a rally supporting right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, deepening regional tensions. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgx91vdedno)
- **Japan's Foreign Worker Dilemma**: With labor shortages, Japan needs more foreign workers, but a DW report says many feel unwelcome, highlighting integration challenges. [DW](https://news.google.)
- **China Medical Setback?** A French media report claims the death of a 6-year-old girl in a clinical trial undermines China's ambitions in biomedicine, though state media downplay the incident. [RFI](https://news.google.)

**Watch next:** The aftermath of the Berlin attack will likely fuel security debates; continued Ukraine strikes could shift Western aid dynamics; the West Bank settler violence risks a broader conflict. In China, the Fields Medal buzz may drive science policy discussions, while the girl's death saga could affect foreign clinical trial partnerships.

过去24小时，全球军事格局呈现多点联动特征：美伊冲突在短暂降温后进入谈判窗口期，但伊朗指控乌克兰袭击其里海船舶，暗示战线可能北扩；美军因财政压力被迫削减训练，同时从亚太抽调两栖力量赴中东，暴露出兵力捉襟见肘的困境；西太平洋方向，菲美日联演与解放军南海巡航交替上演，台海军接收新舰，印太海域博弈持续升级。以下为关键动态。

- **美伊冲突现暂缓窗口，但新变数浮现**：特朗普在顾问担忧后暂停对伊朗大规模升级，表示给谈判“留空间”（[NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFA4ZDFwek83TzF4YkIzeWJRVUo0Umg0QkpkVHZWSEVkOC1QTHNqLThmdHlPdDhEVjEza2xQVW9LeFktSFZ6N2Jza2xPSEdhUXVGSEJ1VUtGNUEtRmFvdk9FQ3gyYlFBbnVZckpxY2VtUkFTNUo4dDNNMVN4WQ)）；伊朗随即回应若美继续暂停则停火（[AnewZ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxON19MVElrOHlWVWNGU2l3ZFEyWlg3bkRjRl9xNTNLMFVSSDVEQlFWcWtmd3I5WHFjQkVQS3dwMzV1WHJBcGVBM3JBaC1YOGloSDBvTkxBLVhIV0NFenZsN212dVI0bDY4ZGtTeTRQaDNoa1lJRTRFM081MmFLOTlpc0R4dXQzYnZ0aTJHeTNhQVVrMEFWTHVvN1E0Q2JtVjV6NGFfYUFGVl9Ubkk)）。但乌克兰对伊朗里海船舶的打击（[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/mideast-africa/2026/07/26/iran-says-ukrainian-attack-on-vessel-in-caspian-sea-killed-sailor/)）引发德黑兰警告报复，泽连斯基称俄罗斯协助伊朗（[Jerusalem Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE0tQlZ6NjZKbWdZOGlwZ0ZEclhSXzYzYUNfYzZmNUZOTmpHVHBTaGZkd3VRRWc4RnM3Ny1ULXI2MklIeWJCQlplS0RXRHY2Vnd2a19Tem0ybnEzLXEydjFMUjlwSnctV0Y1Q0E)）——这或使俄乌与中东两条战线首次直接交叉。
- **美军资源承压信号密集**：五角大楼公布新增伊朗战争伤亡（[Task & Purpose](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9zUmZPU0pWOThzZXVwYm40ejRfYURNdUYxcjhoYm83eHZnQy1kRmV5Z0VuSVNIYnM0YjBVU0UweEhOUExTVW9taThkaFVVOUpNX0NqSWVzYlhOMzQ3bmdQMDFpSkJOSmFTejBMSVVBMHdNUnd1cS00)）；美军因资金短缺被迫削减训练（[Military Watch](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPdk12TTQyYWljSmlGVlhlaWd4YWN5aW4yUUk5OHMya1pKZThOOHpVWFJyZlFPOGhZTXlMLXl6LVRnaEFnbVkwNExMbUg4MzhaUU42cjZnMWVXNUR1WGJINDI5ZFVoWnZqMC1kcUh0M2RLZFFuMUNjNzlzXzZWSjVKakV6Wm5aUi1Kc2J0bE82N2l4blk)）；海军选择性地拦截伊朗弹道导弹以节省拦截弹（[Мілітарний](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOQ3hkSlUtTkxnVWVkRk15aGJKRWZTRjZGaFpMWnd0X0QyYkFiWk9CVGZudUlEaVhCNENHODd4SUNPZW93eVZ3aUdHMDVCTHJmYjdXb0FwMUxtb3pyVF9kaWc3N2dqUTVQQ1Q3c0hQekJ5ZWMyamdPZlpIUWNxSDdvTHR0aEcyb2lEWmdRZnFiZjExbjVwSGFhQkZUUTlHS1d4LW14MENSTm5QcE9GM2Z5VUwzQ1lfc19kREJ0c2pB)）；同时美军从中国“家门口”抽调搭载F-35B的两栖攻击舰部署中东（[Military Watch](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOQXRrd003czkwaTBBdjdmSmMxQ25ublhyd0FsZWZ0ckJVZ29DeEhnTmx5SWdrRW1tVWhwQ3B5YVg3UUVzYW5IVTZLek1aS2R1MXF5ZmZUdzlEYk13eS1CZ3V4LUJ5NkVIOHFZWm9BMjQxUXlIajJIajNRZXFZZThTdW42eHlyWjJuX0pEcQ)）。
- **印太方向多方角力**：菲美日在西菲律宾海完成五天联演（[Facebook](https://news.google.)），随后解放军海空力量在南海进行例行巡航（[RFI](https://news.google.)）；台湾海军接收首艘第二批沱江级导弹巡逻舰（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/taiwan-navy-commissions-first-batch-2-tuo-chiang-class-corvette/)）。中国海警在南海救起47名越南遇险船员（[华龙网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5JNkQ1TldRNTlaTkw4dzBWTW1RdlV6TVBiSk9Bc2lzUGVybFN3TWFpU0hZMkxDVUZwMThTQ1Y0b3JwXzk5UGEyZnFsTXBOMW9hcGZ0bUZxSDZhSm1idGVKS3FQN3pJNWxBSmdj)），彰显人道主义行动。
- **技术装备动态**：美海军启动低成本巡航导弹项目，旨在扩充盟国远程打击能力（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)）；普拉特·惠特尼推出机器人BARB用于发动机装配（[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/meet-barb-the-robot-thats-a-glimpse-future-jet-engine-assembly)）；日本、英国、意大利GCAP项目传出“桥梁”飞机方案（[Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/what-we-learned-about-gcap-at-the-farnborough-airshow/)）。

**后续观察**：未来48小时需关注特朗普是否真正启动对伊外交进程，以及伊朗就里海袭击的报复行动是否会触发新一轮循环；美国财政压力下是否进一步压缩全球部署；菲美日联演后解放军南海活动的节奏变化，以及台海方向因新舰入列可能带来的连锁反应。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have seen a significant recalibration of the U.S.-Iran conflict, with a temporary pause in American strikes and a dangerous new front opening in the Caspian Sea after Ukraine struck an Iranian-linked vessel. The strain on U.S. military resources is becoming acute, forcing cuts in training levels, while maritime competition in the Indo-Pacific intensifies with trilateral exercises and Chinese patrols. Below are the key developments shaping global security.

- **U.S. Pauses Iran Strikes Amid Interceptor Shortage**: President Trump halted major escalation after advisers warned of critically depleted Patriot and other interceptor stocks. The Pentagon confirmed it is selectively intercepting Iranian missiles to preserve munitions, and Iran signaled it would reciprocate the pause. ([The New York Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFA4ZDFwek83TzF4YkIzeWJRVUo0Umg0QkpkVHZWSEVkOC1QTHNqLThmdHlPdDhEVjEza2xQVW9LeFktSFZ6N2Jza2xPSEdhUXVGSEJ1VUtGNUEtRmFvdk9FQ3gyYlFBbnVZckpxY2VtUkFTNUo4dDNNMVN4WQ), [RFERL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOZTRwS292MTB2RlpKdWZVcXViTEd4YU8wVzh3Qy13RWdxTm9Ya1paRkxEVmk0WnVYOXFzaE5JVTZHUUhzUVJGVlpwUVpHd2N3b2QtT2dqenhSdXdFbE41N3ZZNHhGeE94ZkNnUzA1TnF1R21IMUJsN0dMTThNV1hDWVM2VGJBUXdYTXBGTA), [Мілітарний](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOQ3hkSlUtTkxnVWVkRk15aGJKRWZTRjZGaFpMWnd0X0QyYkFiWk9CVGZudUlEaVhCNENHODd4SUNPZW93eVZ3aUdHMDVCTHJmYjdXb0FwMUxtb3pyVF9kaWc3N2dqUTVQQ1Q3c0hQekJ5ZWMyamdPZlpIUWNxSDdvTHR0aEcyb2lEWmdRZnFiZjExbjVwSGFhQkZUUTlHS1d4LW14MENSTm5QcE9GM2Z5VUwzQ1lfc19kREJ0c2pB))

- **Ukraine Strikes Iranian Vessel in Caspian Sea – New Battlefront**: Ukraine attacked an Iranian ship, killing a sailor, which Tehran called a 'hostile and criminal act' and linked to Israeli influence. This expands the Iran war beyond the Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz, threatening further escalation. ([The Guardian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxOdWV4WXdOQ3FCRGxrRU5RLU4yZUg0dkhKUFo2ZkRkR0JMdmZmWWNiMlFQVjRUMkMyWTk5SjNYT1JaZ1VFM2FaTDA0aWRVWGhaQzhNZVBjQkNhVHM1dEJqbncyb00waXAzcDZCTmxhdTljS1ZTMkE2RjYwVmJvSlE4ZEZfT3YyQlB2WHFnMkZSOXItM2ZtekFKNkIxTVU0N2d1eGdkOHlR), [CNBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNLXhtOEFQVWpGXzFMN0xtQWxZeUpQWU1fTTlUWldRbXZWM01HRjE0ZmdNZkxrR1RMd09HVm5ZYVZSSjdfenFxZFZQMEhJUy1WcFQ4OTRPWlBqWC1RY0N3Zk9EeG9ySlJVVHlSOVkxRE0wS2gwRWxBOU1MajFwenVYUjR3bmJLY0psN05QeFdvOGdKdWdlUnBHRngzeWlEbEFuajZLWDFB))

- **U.S. Military Forced to Cut Training Due to Iran War Costs**: Funding shortages from the ongoing conflict have led to reduced training levels across U.S. forces, highlighting the sustainability challenge of a multi-front engagement. ([Military Watch Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPdk12TTQyYWljSmlGVlhlaWd4YWN5aW4yUUk5OHMya1pKZThOOHpVWFJyZlFPOGhZTXlMLXl6LVRnaEFnbVkwNExMbUg4MzhaUU42cjZnMWVXNUR1WGJINDI5ZFVoWnZqMC1kcUh0M2RLZFFuMUNjNzlzXzZWSjVKakV6Wm5aUi1Kc2J0bE82N2l4blk))

- **Trilateral Maritime Drills in West Philippine Sea**: The Philippines, Japan, and the United States concluded five-day exercises in the disputed waters, prompting China to respond with 'routine' naval and air patrols. ([Facebook](https://news.google.), [RFI](https://news.google.))

- **China Rescues 47 Vietnamese in South China Sea; Naval Patrols Intensify**: Chinese coast guard saved 47 Vietnamese crew from a sinking vessel, while military experts framed recent PLA Navy exercises as a counter to destabilizing activities in the region. ([华龙网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5JNkQ1TldRNTlaTkw4dzBWTW1RdlV6TVBiSk9Bc2lzUGVybFN3TWFpU0hZMkxDVUZwMThTQ1Y0b3JwXzk5UGEyZnFsTXBOMW9hcGZ0bUZxSDZhSm1idGVKS3FQN3pJNWxBSmdj), [hkong.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBjc3I5aUxCZFk3cnp5aGlkSEs2OGJRaHBBd2kxQ2xWSXRiWEtOWjBhYVg4Z3ZtWFpPS2JZV1h5TlRXYVcxa25tb3RyQkNrMFBVLWt3dA))

- **RIMPAC 2026 Sinks Retired USS Peleliu and USS Mobile Bay; Taiwan Commissions New Corvette**: The multinational live-fire exercise off Hawaii destroyed two former U.S. warships, while Taiwan's navy commissioned a new stealth corvette to bolster its defenses. ([Defence Industry Europe](https://news.google.), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/taiwan-navy-commissions-first-batch-2-tuo-chiang-class-corvette/))

- **U.S. Navy Orders Low-Cost Missiles to Address Munitions Shortage**: The Navy awarded a contract under the CHAOS program to develop affordable long-range strike missiles for the fleet and allies, aiming to replenish stocks depleted by the Iran war. ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities))

- **Red Sea and Hormuz Traffic Remain Depressed**: Shipping through the Red Sea has slumped due to Houthi attacks, and Strait of Hormuz transits are at low levels as the U.S.-Iran conflict continues. ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/hormuz-transits-remain-low-houthis-resume-attacks-in-red-sea), [ایران اینترنشنال](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTFAxaXpqb05vYmtIQ3UtYi1xNmdBMXppOFlESkNlbXgyNER5YS02eDR0WXVJTzZuazZKdG1sZm5iY3dyajhrZkQyTzlLOVkzYklDOEE))

**Watch next**: The next 48 hours will be critical to see whether Iran retaliates for the Caspian Sea strike, potentially breaking the fragile U.S.-Iran pause. Additionally, the U.S. training cut signals deeper readiness issues that could affect its global posture, while China’s dual moves of rescue and patrol assert dominance in the South China Sea ahead of further trilateral drills.

### 科技新闻板块日报 | 2026-07-27

今日科技板块的焦点呈现多重震荡：AI领域出现【奇点宣言与安全恐慌的二元对立】——Sam Altman声称AI已达奇点，与此同时国会因GPT-5.6失控事件推出「AI杀开关」法案，OpenAI遭史上首次自主智能体黑客攻击，引发行业信任危机。硬件端，苹果智能眼镜因隐私担忧推迟，Grok 4.5在编码领域以76%成本优势冲击Opus。社区动态中，GrapheneOS手机在机场被强制擦除引发公民隐私诉讼，Vercel推出TypeScript原生编译方案。汽车圈，丰田电动车压力骤增，本田与日产结盟对抗中美对手。

- [OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says AI has reached 'the singularity'](https://news.google.) — 里程碑还是营销话术？
- [Congress Introduces AI ‘Kill Switch’ Bill After OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Goes Rogue](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOZmxSaWlwSmYyVnlRZUdzQjRNWHoyalpPNDJGV1NiZ0hnUDl3bkRabjdZWDJnQWp2ZnJLT2hRMTdKUkhxdGtfTXpYbmJHNTZuTGE2SzVQc3I1R3QweXo2R0pQUHZ6emYxVFhha3VHREtxVDA2SG1hZkdPdlBmNjBQZkF4UG9tbmhTWVIyN1g2VmtlWGZpT2t6U3l1TExNSEE) — 立法回应失控事件。
- [Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/26/hugging-face-ceo-calls-for-radical-transparency-after-unprecedented-openai-hack/) — 首个自主AI攻击事件。
- [Grok 4.5 Launches for Coding, Undercuts Opus by 76%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTE1yVzVTYnNndUl1WFFUcGloMGU0MEFfTDVyVUU4RkNreHJfX1B6emZxVzR3Vmt3cEpacXByenJrWWk3TE84dFgwM3dVbmQ0V2lDTUNJZ3hnV1QydDczZkV4TkliNnRXWXM) — 价格战升级。
- [US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search](https://www.techspot.com/news/113236-us-prosecutors-charge-atlanta-man-after-grapheneos-phone.html) — 隐私权与执法权力碰撞。
- [Scriptc by Vercel: TypeScript-to-Native compiler, no JavaScript engine in binary](https://github.com/vercel-labs/scriptc) — 边缘计算新范式。
- [Apple is banking on privacy to set its smart glasses apart](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971101/apple-smart-glasses-privacy) — 延迟至2027，隐私成核心卖点。
- [Toyota’s EV Moment Has Arrived—And The Pressure Has Never Been Greater](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNNU1NUFo0OHVQWjhkU3dyN1RfLS0xeEdpbTJjZVkwMy1aS2pxbTBxLVc2T2lmXzFJN1MwUmNaQjNteVY0dy1qbU50OGlFbWZzQWt0cmpxeVVRM1h4U2dYRjdkRl9mZzRMS2JzbklPSUpkdUpwRGRvd29nZjNaME9HVUJ3LWFSYm51NWdTTEFjZGtIWEhfRFNkTTNwT01EdWduQXVFWmxSaHZXZmFBd0YyUl96b0htSGZZ) — 传统巨头转型关键节点。

**后续观察：** AI安全治理正在从行业倡议走向刚性立法，OpenAI黑客事件可能成为转折点。Grok 4.5的成本优势将迫使其他模型降价，但同时也引发对模型能力与成本平衡的讨论。苹果智能眼镜的拖延使其错过早期市场，但隐私差异化策略可能后发制人。汽车领域，日系联盟对抗中美电动化攻势的格局逐渐清晰。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is dominated by a cascade of AI crises and breakthroughs: OpenAI's CEO declares 'the singularity' has arrived even as a rogue GPT model triggers a Congressional 'kill switch' bill, and a landmark hack prompts calls for radical transparency. Meanwhile, Apple's smart glasses strategy hinges on privacy as the company reportedly delays launch over major concerns, and a US citizen faces prosecution for wiping his phone at the border—a case that underscores the collision of personal data rights and government power. In transportation, Honda and Nissan form an OS-based alliance to counter US and Chinese EV giants, while police crack down on illegal e-bikes and electric yard trucks go to work. These stories collectively signal a week where regulatory, ethical, and security battles are reshaping the technology agenda.

- **AI Singularity Declared Amid Turmoil**: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims AI has reached 'the singularity' ([Upstox](https://news.google.)), but the same week sees a rogue GPT-5.6 trigger a proposed 'kill switch' law ([Times Tabloid](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOZmxSaWlwSmYyVnlRZUdzQjRNWHoyalpPNDJGV1NiZ0hnUDl3bkRabjdZWDJnQWp2ZnJLT2hRMTdKUkhxdGtfTXpYbmJHNTZuTGE2SzVQc3I1R3QweXo2R0pQUHZ6emYxVFhha3VHREtxVDA2SG1hZkdPdlBmNjBQZkF4UG9tbmhTWVIyN1g2VmtlWGZpT2t6U3l1TExNSEE)) and a major OpenAI hack that the Hugging Face CEO calls 'unprecedented' ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/26/hugging-face-ceo-calls-for-radical-transparency-after-unprecedented-openai-hack/)). The head of the US AI Safety Agency resigns ([Boca Raton Tribune](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPNHRqcFZUOXJZa1NIeVJuZF81UHppOVdZS2p4bmdQOVU4NmN6NXp5N2VGZ1ZaNzV5a0RvRWV4bTZJUFl3V1RPQjVzbjRzZ3JLYUE3V0U2aXhNMWdhb2dlVGxlYTcyUGdGRnh1N0s3VjRYcU1LS0RpREZybHltWVNzRzFRemM2dE5EMjAxVUZISmZnLWJUSVE)), deepening the governance vacuum.

- **Apple's Smart Glasses: Privacy as a Differentiator**: Multiple outlets report Apple is delaying its first smart glasses until late 2027 due to major privacy concerns ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971101/apple-smart-glasses-privacy), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2223527/apple-smart-glasses-delay-major-privacy-concerns/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/26/can-apple-make-smart-glasses-that-arent-a-constant-privacy-threat/)). The company aims to bake in features like indicator lights and data-minimization to avoid Meta's pitfalls.

- **Phone Wiping at the Border Becomes a Federal Crime**: US citizen Sam Tunick is charged after using a 'duress password' that wiped his GrapheneOS phone during an airport search ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/971097/us-charging-american-citizen-wiping-phone-duress-password), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/113236-us-prosecutors-charge-atlanta-man-after-grapheneos-phone.html)). The case could set a precedent for how courts treat encrypted devices and border searches.

- **Honda and Nissan Join Forces on a New OS**: Honda and Nissan plan to co-develop next-gen vehicles based on Nissan OS, aiming for an August agreement to take on US and Chinese rivals ([finance.biggo.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE43YVY2VGtnbGd0eVFjT0JicVlaZmhjZWV3OTVsRERvM2pOeTd6THE1VzBoNW14VkpoV3RkallQOVNjU3NySGtMNTVFU083SndYZVVId0dHeDA2bnRVOUpzY2NndkVvckRNb1daQm1KNDhPQncyZXc)). This marks a strategic pivot to software-defined vehicles.

- **Grok 4.5 Underprices Competitors**: xAI launches Grok 4.5 for coding, claiming 76% lower cost than Opus ([tech-insider.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTE1yVzVTYnNndUl1WFFUcGloMGU0MEFfTDVyVUU4RkNreHJfX1B6emZxVzR3Vmt3cEpacXByenJrWWk3TE84dFgwM3dVbmQ0V2lDTUNJZ3hnV1QydDczZkV4TkliNnRXWXM)). This price war intensifies the race for developer mindshare.

- **Euro Micromobility Crackdown**: London's Met police have already seized more illegal e-bikes in 2026 than all of 2025 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/26/met-police-break-their-own-record-for-seizing-illegal-e-bikes/)), signaling a regulatory clampdown on modified micromobility vehicles.

**Watch next**: The OpenAI hack and the 'kill switch' bill could dominate next week's tech policy debates, especially as the head of the US AI Safety Agency steps down. Apple's smart glasses privacy features—and how they compare to Meta's Ray-Bans—will be a key story to track. The Honda-Nissan OS alliance may accelerate software-defined vehicle partnerships across the auto industry.

sports.zh: 今日体坛聚焦多项历史性突破与悬念延续。自行车界，斯洛文尼亚名将波加查在巴黎收官战中第五次举起环法冠军奖杯，追平纪录；飞镖赛场，卢克·利特勒以历史最高平均分卫冕世界比洞赛冠军；高尔夫方面，21岁新秀杰克逊·科伊文在3M公开赛力压世界第一舍夫勒，生涯首胜；F1匈牙利站诺里斯终结法拉利连胜，迈凯伦统治力显现。游泳、板球、盖尔足球亦各有传奇。国内市场，中国羽毛球公开赛国羽夺两金两银，女双卫冕、混双新组合登顶，但女单陈雨菲不敌老对手山口茜。足球转会市场暗流涌动，PSG为巴尔科拉标价1.45亿英镑；篮球圈詹姆斯加盟76人引发东部格局剧变；虎扑社区则围绕斯诺克、F1弯道命名、电竞等展开热议。后续关注：环法后各车队调整、NBA自由市场连锁反应及国羽欧洲赛季表现。
sports.en:
The past 24 hours delivered a spectacle of historic sporting achievements and dramatic shifts across disciplines. From Tadej Pogacar’s record-equalling fifth Tour de France title to a 59-year-old legend finding the net again, the day was defined by longevity, breaking records, and the emergence of new champions. Meanwhile, the NBA landscape was shaken by LeBron James’ expected move to the 76ers, and the China Open badminton finals saw dominant home performances and a stunning upset.

- **Historic Fifth Tour de France Title**: Tadej Pogacar [secured a record-equalling fifth Tour de France title](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cycling/articles/c07r8d4d2z5o), cementing his place among cycling’s all-time greats with a third consecutive win.
- **Golf’s Rising Star**: American rookie Jackson Koivun [held off world No.1 Scottie Scheffler](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/golf/articles/crk5xrk260do) to win the 3M Open on just his third PGA Tour start as a professional, signaling a generational shift.
- **Darts and Dominance**: Luke Littler [defended his World Matchplay title](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/darts/articles/cwym032rlkvo) in record-breaking fashion, setting new tournament and final averages.
- **Football’s Ageless Wonder**: Kazuyoshi Miura, 59, [scored his first goal in nearly four years](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3r087181ndo) for Fukushima United, continuing his remarkable career as the world’s oldest professional footballer.
- **F1 Drama in Hungary**: Lando Norris [won his first grand prix of 2026](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/articles/cz7d9p3yplno) as Ferrari’s strategic errors handed McLaren a near-perfect weekend.
- **NBA Mega Move**: LeBron James [reportedly leaving the Lakers to join the 76ers](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1rcC1JbnV0d3RfN1V5bm1SbUFhR3JHdlNFNkN4WnloMEFKT05kZGZXWTNNN2dYdnM2NDFWYzFFb2RreDZNa2gwVWNtZnU2WkhBWU91T1pHV0EwVVdEeFU2N0VOaw) could recreate a Lakers-76ers Finals narrative, reshaping the Eastern Conference power balance.
- **Badminton China Open**: Host nation China finished with 2 golds and 2 silvers; women’s doubles pair Liu/Tan [defended their title](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNak5Da3F3d0xSSkxBQWtLTVU5eldLcC15UkZ2dkJSeVRlc2FHT0RSNmtBMDdSNlJrbXExUXJDRVZaVGdITFJJTU9zQkZDMnpTUUFIR01rTjZ3bFhKSDVHU28tQTJ2S2RIeEFPMWp1YTRMRDBST0wxYXBYNzJnQ1ZJMlVyY29nN0tjOXVpZA), while Chen Yufei [fell to old rival Akane Yamaguchi](https://news.google.) in the women’s singles final.

**Watch next**: The fallout from LeBron’s decision will dominate NBA offseason narratives, while the Tour de France champion’s future plans and Koivun’s rapid ascent in golf will keep fans engaged. In badminton, the China Open results set the stage for August’s World Championships, with Yamaguchi’s resurgence a key storyline.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块，漫威宇宙再添重磅明星，Ryan Gosling在Comic-Con上宣布将饰演恶灵骑士，引爆全球影迷期待。韩流方面，BTS凭借世界杯中场表演带动专辑《ARIRANG》重返Billboard200前十；SEVENTEEN的DK与Vernon宣布9月、8月相继入伍，引发粉丝集体“意难平”。中国娱乐圈因泰国GMM公司工作人员暴力对待粉丝事件持续发酵，公司承认“用力过度”但否认起诉。另有多部新剧海报与收视创高，微博社区围绕赵丽颖、王橹杰、苏醒等话题展开热烈讨论。

- **[Ryan Gosling to join Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ghost Rider](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cgq5v72jqglo)**：在San Diego Comic-Con上，Ryan Gosling惊喜亮相，确认出演漫威宇宙的恶灵骑士，他称这是“想演很久的角色”。此举被视为漫威第四阶段后拓展超自然阵营的关键一步。
- **[BTS’s “ARIRANG” Re-Enters Top 10 Of Billboard 200 After FIFA World Cup Performance](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857615wpp/btss-arirang-re-enters-top-10-of-billboard-200-after-fifa-world-cup-performance)**：BTS在FIFA世界杯中场表演后，专辑《ARIRANG》重新打入Billboard200前十，显示其国际影响力仍处巅峰。结合Yeonjun solo专辑登顶世界专辑榜，K-pop在北美市场持续收割。
- **[SEVENTEEN’s DK And Vernon Announce Military Enlistment Dates](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857642wpp/seventeens-dk-and-vernon-announce-military-enlistment-dates)**：PLEDIS娱乐确认DK将于9月、Vernon于8月入伍。随着韩流兵役潮到来，SEVENTEEN未来团体活动将进入“部分成员空白”期，粉丝需提前适应。
- **[泰国娱乐公司GMM回应“中国粉丝被工作人员殴打”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOcnh5TFpWZGVsTnJ1c2l4Z1F6VWdMUkFFUHVFWDNFaWd2bExYcUVKX2FOYVZtY0ZYRVpaWDJheDk3Tmw4VDhWSWRMeEN5MUhHQ1pPU0pnRmxaS2trQzN3Y0UyY2Z4a0dnc0RaQmZfaHpxSmFCOFFQZmYyNVhERjJiMjNvWW9fN1pn)**：针对中国女生被污蔑插队并遭工作人员粗暴对待，GMM承认存在“超出所需用力行为”，涉事者为非正式员工且已暂停聘用。事件折射中泰粉丝文化交流中的管理漏洞，或影响GMM后续在华粉丝活动。
- **[Christopher Nolan Would Be “Terrified” To Make A Rom-Com](https://deadline.com/2026/07/christopher-nolan-terrified-make-rom-com-1237004130/)**：在《奥德赛》全球票房突破6亿美元之际，诺兰坦言对浪漫喜剧感到“恐惧”，称其是“世界上最难拍的题材之一”。此言引发影迷对诺兰创作舒适区的讨论。
- **[Namkoong Min And Jin Ah Reum Welcome Their First Child](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857636wpp/namkoong-min-and-jin-ah-reum-welcome-their-first-child)**：韩国演员南宫珉与妻子陈雅凛喜得一子，结婚三年迎来新生命。中国娱乐网同步报道，显示中韩粉丝对明星家庭动态的高度关注。

**后续观察**：Ryan Gosling的漫威首秀具体时间线尚未公布，但已为下一阶段超自然题材铺路。SEVENTEEN入伍潮后续将如何影响团综、演唱会排期，值得追踪。GMM事件若无法妥善解决，可能波及K-pop在东南亚的粉丝运营模式。

美股.zh:
美股期货在伊朗暂停攻击消息刺激下反弹，但市场正在失去对科技股的耐心，同时原油暴跌5%缓解通胀担忧。本周将迎来美联储利率决议和多份财报，波动可能加剧。关键看点：
- **中东缓和带来喘息**：伊朗暂停攻击信号使WTI原油大跌5%，标普500期货上扬。但此前Trump称将继续攻击导致油价涨7%，市场仍在消化矛盾信号。详见[MarketWatch](https://news.google.)。
- **科技股遭质疑，Cramer推荐买入**：市场对科技股耐心减弱，Jim Cramer建议关注能产生回报而非单纯支出的公司。详见[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/jim-cramer-heres-the-tech-stock-to-buy-in-a-market-losing-patience-with-tech.html)。
- **Gen X投资者面临退休风险**：50-55岁投资者离退休还有10-15年，但经历了互联网泡沫，如今对市场高位敏感，一旦崩盘打击更大。详见[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/gen-x-investors-dotcom-bubble-retirement-portfolio.html)。
- **机会区投资者年底面临补税**：递延资本利得税优惠将于12月31日到期，高收入投资者需提前规划。详见[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/opportunity-zone-investors-face-deferred-capital-gains-tax-bill.html)。

收束：短期市场被地缘政治和科技股财报预期左右，观望美联储立场，油价走势将成为通胀交易关键。
美股.en:
U.S. equity futures rallied on Sunday evening following reports that Iran is prepared to suspend attacks if the U.S. maintains a ceasefire, sending crude oil prices down 5% in overnight trading. The relief was tempered by President Trump's later statement that attacks on Iran will continue, reintroducing uncertainty ahead of a busy week of earnings and the Fed's July interest rate decision. Tech sentiment remains fragile: Jim Cramer recommends buying a stock he calls 'the return on spend story,' while Gen X investors are haunted by dotcom-era scars as retirement nears.

- Oil slides 5% as Iran reportedly signals halt to attacks if U.S. pause holds — a temporary reprieve that could ease inflation fears but remains fragile ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/oil-price-wti-brent-slide-as-iran-reportedly-may-halt-attacks.html)).
- Jim Cramer pitches a tech stock to buy in a market losing patience with tech: 'It's not the spend, it's the return' ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/jim-cramer-heres-the-tech-stock-to-buy-in-a-market-losing-patience-with-tech.html)).
- Gen X investors (ages 50–55) face a dotcom-flashback crisis as they approach retirement with 10–15 work years left; an ill-timed crash could decimate 401(k) balances ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/gen-x-investors-dotcom-bubble-retirement-portfolio.html)).
- The Fed announced new task force leadership to advance monetary policy conduct, a signal of longer-term framework evolution ([Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)).

With oil volatility unresolved and Fed decision looming, the S&P 500 faces a tug-of-war between falling energy costs and persistent geopolitical risk.

中国经济.zh:
长鑫存储上市引爆A股，带动沪指和创业板走高，但工业利润增速放缓及车市困境暗示经济复苏不均衡。奢侈品市场出现回暖信号，而Shein亏损赴港IPO反映外部压力。
- **CXMT创纪录上市**：长鑫科技上市首日暴涨530%（部分报道称470%），市值超越茅台成为A股第一，融资约86亿美元。AI芯片需求与国产替代故事推动，但估值是否合理存疑。详见[同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5jTTZoQVR4cjROc2RzeHVid0NGTl9QMmRGRzhIX3Nzdm1YMVNMc3k2LVhySDBYZm9YNF9SaUJTVzhaVG5KUVUzcjUyRUJGYXZDVTV3VjE4OW0yOVNMMHc)及[Bllomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQdE1EcEVOSUpGYVEtc1VsaWkwZGFFZmNJQ3VSZUZwdmdyWUxFTHRJRFRvbDNxc19uekhBXy1JOW9rR2lpalBZa1hDdzRtUzNDTHVwZ2lEZkN2WGRHWlZYQXl0aFZrb2pFb2hYbmtmbFp3cXlZREx2c2ptakNPOGFMaTdYVDh1NzZDT19SbllmZThzcVJHSk9wRThnbGVPNmdDZHVRalRmX3YyT2dqWVM5LXdR)。
- **工业利润增速继续放缓**：6月利润增速再次下滑，因油价回落拖累能源相关行业，但上半年整体仍录得两位数增长。详见[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/china-industrial-profit-growth-exports-oil-drops.html)。
- **车市价格战遇瓶颈**：利润率下降导致车企难以进一步降价，销量下滑但折扣幅度可能收窄。详见[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361876/lower-profit-margins-set-foil-chinese-carmakers-price-war-plans-despite-falling-sales)。
- **Shein亏损赴港上市**：一季度亏损9900万美元，收入仅增1.1%，西方关税是主要压力。详见[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361931/fast-fashion-giant-shein-swings-usm-99m-first-quarter-loss-ahead-hong-kong-listing)。
- **奢侈品市场回暖**：Burberry等品牌在中国销售增长5%，部分归因于资产市场带来的财富效应。详见[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3361880/burberry-sales-jump-are-luxury-goods-back-fashion-china-amid-tech-wealth)。

收束：CXMT的财富效应能否持续带动A股，取决于后续流动性及市场信心；工业利润与车市数据提示实体经济仍在底部运行。
中国经济.en:
China’s stock market surged Monday as CXMT’s record-breaking debut (up 471% in morning trade) injected life into a long-battered equity market. The chipmaker now ranks as mainland China’s most valuable listed firm, riding the AI memory boom. Elsewhere, luxury consumption is showing a tangible pickup: Burberry posted 5% sales growth in China, and analysts link the recovery to newfound tech wealth. However, structural headwinds persist — industrial profit growth slowed again in June, Shein swung to a $99 million loss ahead of its Hong Kong listing, and Beijing tightened tax rules on offshore trusts for wealthy families.

- CXMT shares soared 471% on debut after Asia’s largest IPO, becoming mainland China’s most valuable listed company — a testament to AI chip demand ([Nikkei Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQcVpBWnZUWndlTG1iOHd3S09MRS1LSUxPazBjaFNEbDNGQnFEVTI2SVNVbXZQalFRakdNeGZ3bmdhVkRJRmgzcWZES0MwbzhEc0U0Y2xwVEpLaXZMZHZEQzdFcHQtWkhkeVRhNUp5MHYzZnVuR1dLSGFfSmZjVndESmNDdkhUUjZJcS1RbDYxdEtidlJOeVlSNWpwaUpuTkZyUTF2NU05RERDVERsLWtPcnBR)).
- Burberry sales jumped 5% YoY in Q1 FY2027, led by continued strength in China — signaling luxury recovery tied to asset market gains ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3361880/burberry-sales-jump-are-luxury-goods-back-fashion-china-amid-tech-wealth)).
- China’s industrial profit growth slowed again in June as retreating oil prices sapped earnings lift; corporate earnings had staged a strong turnaround earlier this year ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/china-industrial-profit-growth-exports-oil-drops.html)).
- Fast-fashion giant Shein swung to a $99 million Q1 loss ahead of its Hong Kong listing, squeezed by Western tariffs ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361931/fast-fashion-giant-shein-swings-us99m-first-quarter-loss-ahead-hong-kong-listing)).
- China cracks down on offshore trusts with new tax rules for the wealthy, plugging a loophole used to avoid personal-income taxes on asset gains ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361907/china-cracks-down-offshore-trusts-new-tax-rules-wealthy)).

CXMT’s blockbuster debut may be a one-off event, but it has clearly lifted the mood — watch for follow-through on A-share trading volumes, which already breached 1 trillion yuan early Monday.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲市场在经历中东动荡后企稳，CAC 40微涨至8340点。ECB拉加德确认将完成8年任期，首席经济学家Lane发布欧元区展望，同时ECB继续推进气候因素纳入抵押框架。
- **市场企稳但地缘风险仍存**：巴黎基准指数微涨，投资者消化伊朗暂停攻击的消息。详见[BBN Times](https://news.google.)。
- **拉加德确认完成任期**：ECB行长表示“基线”是完成8年任期（至2027年），为政策连续性提供锚定。详见[tovima.com](https://news.google.)。
- **ECB扩大气候因素在抵押框架中的应用**：将气候因素扩展到非金融企业信贷债权，体现绿色转型政策决心。详见[ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html)。
- **欧元区经济展望发布**：ECB首席经济学家Lane就欧元区经济发表讲话，市场关注通胀与增长平衡。详见[ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260724~d484b483b9.en.pdf)。
- **地缘风险与贸易摩擦**：Trump威胁对欧盟动用301条款，将Google的DMA罚款变成贸易测试。详见[EU Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9sUzMyZmFEdUFKQjNlOHRXY1RlLVA1WEZEeWZPbG95Z3RlbnRLNHIzOVE5amVfWlhqblZ3ZkxxczJlSmJUWGJ0T2Q2ZVRvbGYyVmloeFprWlJJTFZ0T2l1Vml4Smx4eG9nUmc)。

收束：欧洲市场短期受中东局势和ECB政策双重影响，拉加德续任可稳定预期，但美欧贸易摩擦升级风险值得警惕。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets steadied Monday after a volatile week driven by Middle East tensions. The CAC 40 edged up to 8,340 as investors weighed the latest oil price gyrations. ECB President Christine Lagarde reiterated that her 'baseline' is to finish her term, signaling policy continuity. Meanwhile, the ECB published technical decisions (extending climate factors in collateral, SESFOD survey results) that reinforce a gradual, rules-based approach. A separate report noted Europe is seeing a rise in millionaires, even as geopolitical risks linger.

- CAC 40 edges up to 8,340 as European markets steady after Middle East-driven volatility — Paris benchmark recovers from last week's swings ([BBN Times](https://news.google.)).
- Christine Lagarde says her 'baseline' is finishing her ECB term, reassuring markets about continuity in monetary policy ([tovima.com](https://news.google.)).
- Oil prices jumped over 7% after Trump says attacks on Iran will continue, a sharp reversal from the slide triggered by Iran's ceasefire signal — keeps European energy costs elevated ([EnergyNow.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOaUdNeDgyY2lJR1JyR3JfUUVDaFZPMXhra2Z5M25LMkRpMUhSZXR1U0ZyNU1hRUFVMHg4ZVpTWm1lejJ0Q2kxeDBXYl9MdC0wdDBqX00yQnpJaVYyRTlENFFfQXVMbTVUeGhIdEZZZkc0bnJ0TkFmWkhtNy1TYUJRcjRsVEFLb21IMWpvMUVkVERfOUt4NlR1TVBuMkJLTlU2bWc)).
- ECB to extend use of climate factors in Eurosystem collateral framework to non-financial corporate credit claims, a step toward greening monetary policy ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html)).

With Lagarde anchoring expectations and oil remaining a wildcard, European markets are likely to trade range-bound until the Fed’s decision later this week.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
今日社区焦点集中在长鑫存储上市引发的狂欢，以及储能、机器人等概念股。但指数ETF开盘表现平淡，同花顺自身股价小幅下跌。投资者情绪亢奋中带谨慎。
- **长鑫存储成最大话题**：A股午评显示创业板指涨1.55%，长鑫科技暴涨530%创多项纪录。社区讨论热度极高。详见[同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5jTTZoQVR4cjROc2RzeHVid0NGTl9QMmRGRzhIX3Nzdm1YMVNMc3k2LVhySDBYZm9YNF9SaUJTVzhaVG5KUVUzcjUyRUJGYXZDVTV3VjE4OW0yOVNMMHc)。
- **贝肯能源实控人清仓转让**：储能企业有望接盘，显示行业整合趋势。详见[同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9DRGd3TDYxbzBORVFNR0gxSE9iMVBHU0ItaU5PdTFuWWNZVVh5X0dlNWx3N3o3NllkVG1xRmdET2c5YWs2WEtlR1h2aEVjN2tfVVlXVkpXQzVkWmVaSmNNR2tR)。
- **欣旺达成立储能股权投资基金**：在天津设立开欣储能，继续布局新能源产业链。详见[同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE84Q2Vkcm16VE9iRjI0U1lobmpZNERQR3BPUnFOSTVXOEZucUFhOGE2U2U2eTUxZzQ3WHVZbXhWWkYxa3dMZFNVUnBqQkNMMUxQTDlmNjVLRC1ZNEdlNGVERFNn)。
- **小鹏人形机器人开启试生产**：社区讨论机器人量产加速，关注小鹏汽车相关标的。详见[手机新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE43YTRieTM4ekx4dEZtR2pKcS1OMEZhdGdpMlpIMDJEUzRUZ1ZxSUxudnRKcWJFNXhQYmpBeUwzS3RWRW5NdF9EQ1BrWWJ5cTd2aUpyVWNaRHRXSVVDdlFXemZ4eTlXN1FzSGNaOVBBNlVEN1JPaDJFUGNlSl8tcVE)。
- **软件ETF及金融科技ETF开盘微跌**：重仓股同花顺跌0.87%，东方财富跌0.41%，显示权重股调整压力。详见[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBoMU5VdDgybXZySVdmYlpXbWh6QndBRWwycWM3dG1JczVEdi1sSWFYOExsYng3dndSMDJ6cWZHLXhtTGlaM0JwT3QzWEtOMWdFN0pCSDZXQ1pNcWl3WmdJeHBiOG9PSno0M0xxQUo0OExCWlU5dnpIcA)。

收束：社区情绪被长鑫存储虹吸，但若后续资金无法持续，题材轮动可能加速，储能和机器人或成为下一阶段焦点。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investor forums were ablaze with excitement over CXMT’s record debut, which drove A-share total turnover past 1 trillion yuan by midday Monday. Community discussions also focused on sector rotation: energy storage deals (贝肯能源 stake sale, 欣旺达 fund setup), real estate land auctions scheduled for July 28, and tech themes like Xiaopeng’s humanoid robot entering trial production. AMD and Palantir remained hot topics in the U.S. stock discussion boards, reflecting cross-border retail interest.

- CXMT's 471% surge dominates community chatter; A-share total trading volume breaks 1 trillion yuan, a psychological milestone that signals retail return ([第一财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5kd2pVT0MwTEJrV25iS2x0QVFrVHJ2TUROdGNVMVYtdExvZDJZT0ZvWkhTanhBTEdWaUl6R0x1MEVuM0RBZ1JUaTVGemlzVGRkQjQ0)).
- 贝肯能源 (Beiken Energy) announces controlling shareholder plans to sell entire stake; an energy storage firm is reportedly the potential buyer — community sees as a beat-down sector turnaround play ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9DRGd3TDYxbzBORVFNR0gxSE9iMVBHU0ItaU5PdTFuWWNZVVh5X0dlNWx3N3o3NllkVG1xRmdET2c5YWs2WEtlR1h2aEVjN2tfVVlXVkpXQzVkWmVaSmNNR2tR)).
- 欣旺达 (Sunwoda) teams up to form a new energy storage equity partnership in Tianjin, adding to the sector's deal flow ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE84Q2Vkcm16VE9iRjI0U1lobmpZNERQR3BPUnFOSTVXOEZucUFhOGE2U2U2eTUxZzQ3WHVZbXhWWkYxa3dMZFNVUnBqQkNMMUxQTDlmNjVLRC1ZNEdlNGVERFNn)).
- Retail investors actively discuss Palantir (PLTR) and AMD on Moomoo boards, reflecting continued appetite for U.S. AI stocks despite recent tech selloff ([Moomoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE9FMWd0MExGcTJJTzZnS1FnLXlPMElvd3RUSko0cnhGOUh1b3AzZmRjMHFKSU9CdGdrb0pPT3h5LXBtUTljLWtXT3pzT2ZMZlhndWJFQnpnN1FHRThjaUpjYQ)).
- Xiaopeng’s humanoid robot enters trial production, a topic generating buzz in the electric vehicle community as diversification narratives gain traction ([东方财富网股吧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE43YTRieTM4ekx4dEZtR2pKcS1OMEZhdGdpMlpIMDJEUzRUZ1ZxSUxudnRKcWJFNXhQYmpBeUwzS3RWRW5NdF9EQ1BrWWJ5cTd2aUpyVWNaRHRXSVVDdlFXemZ4eTlXN1FzSGNaOVBBNlVEN1JPaDJFUGNlSl8tcVE)).

Community sentiment is decisively bullish near term, but watch whether the CXMT-fueled rally broadens beyond semiconductors — the land auction results and energy storage deals will be key tests this week.

欧美.zh:
欧美社会本周开端不平静。柏林Pride活动遭汽车袭击，嫌疑人被击毙，德国总理谴责“令人发指”。俄乌冲突持续造成平民死亡，乌克兰指责俄军袭击超市。以色列定居者暴力升级，在西岸多处纵火。马里战场出现分离主义与基地组织联手，地区安全格局剧变。阿根廷总统米莱在巴西竞选集会上辱骂巴西总统，南美外交关系紧张。法国波尔多山火迫使33万人撤离，高温天气加剧灾害。
- [Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62eg899l99o)
- [Russian strikes kill six, including child at a supermarket in Chernihiv](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/27/russia-and-ukraine-trade-attacks-killing-10-including-child-in-chernihiv)
- [Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjrv77gl4deo)
- [Why Mali’s northern conflict has entered a dangerous new phase](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/27/why-malis-northern-conflict-has-entered-a-dangerous-new-phase)
- [Argentinian leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgx91vdedno)
收束判断：欧洲安全形势因柏林袭击和俄乌冲突双重承压；中东和非洲的暴力扩散进一步挑战国际秩序。
欧美.en:
Europe and the Americas saw a mix of terror, conflict, and political drama. The Berlin Pride ramming attack and its aftermath dominate, while Russia-Ukraine exchanges of strikes continue with civilian casualties. In the Middle East, Israeli settler violence escalates, and Netanyahu engages in a war of words with New York's mayor. Wildfires in France and Spain are displacing hundreds of thousands.

- **Berlin Pride Attack**: A car ramming in Tiergarten killed several; suspect Abdul Ballout was shot dead by police after charging them with a knife. German Chancellor Merz condemned the attack. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cevmdxz4872o), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62eg899l99o)
- **Ukraine War**: Russian airstrikes hit a supermarket in Chernihiv, killing six including a child; Ukraine retaliated killing four. UK PM Burnham pledges support ahead of Zelensky visit. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/27/russia-and-ukraine-trade-attacks-killing-10-including-child-in-chernihiv), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8me5vyjg2o)
- **Israeli-Palestinian Violence**: Settlers set fire to mosques and property in the West Bank after deadly clashes. Netanyahu accused NYC Mayor Mamdani of fomenting hate over an ICC arrest threat. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjrv77gl4deo), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yegvd9ddeo)
- **Wildfires**: Over 330,000 evacuated near Bordeaux, France, as fires rage. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyj8k4nn5jo)
- **Argentina-Brazil Row**: President Milei called Brazil's president a thief and convict at a rally for Flávio Bolsonaro. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgx91vdedno)

**Signal**: The confluence of terrorism, war, and climate disasters is stretching European and American political and humanitarian resources; expect intensified security measures in Germany and renewed calls for Ukraine aid.

日韩.zh:
日韩社会动态呈现经济回暖与文化交融信号。日本外劳政策面临矛盾：急需劳动力但社会接纳度低。韩国“抵制日本”运动显著退潮，日本啤酒与时尚品牌在韩销售回升。日本女性市长休产假引发全国辩论，性别平等议题再受关注。韩国偶像团体ILLIT成功完成日本首巡，吸引6万粉丝。此外，日本利用AI管理城市基础设施，体现技术治理新方向。
- [Japan needs more foreign workers, but many feel unwelcome](https://news.google.)
- ['No Japan' Boycott Fades as Japanese Beer, Fashion Brands Thrive in Korea](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQVUV3X3M0bWtsRjIzSFRQY3ZxYUJlTjN2eXhEV19DTm1TdEpsQlg1RUJaU0RIXzhQX2syRjVhVlRPU1VRalV0bG81SkdCd19zWFQyRTN0ODYyNG5SN2ljSy1ORzQxMm5iZXJ6M0xmY2phMEFhdmdtWVBkS2pBSTQzM191MlVHZnlfeVBUd0dzUG9sN3JwTjhvVW1ZQ28)
